title: North Carolina's 10th Congressional District election, 2026
description: This race will decide who represents North Carolina's 10th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives. The district, which was redrawn in October 2025, covers parts of the western Piedmont and Foothills region including Hickory and portions of Winston-Salem. Incumbent Republican Pat Harrigan, a freshman congressman and former Green Beret, is seeking a second term. He faces Democratic nominee Ashley Bell, a physician assistant and educator who won a six-candidate primary in March 2026. The general election presents voters with a contrast between Harrigan's conservative record on border security and economic issues and Bell's progressive platform focused on healthcare reform and government accountability.
polling_note: One general-election matchup poll was identified on the Wikipedia page for the 2026 North Carolina House elections, showing Harrigan at 51% and Bell at 38% with 11% undecided/other. Margin of error ±5.0% among 400 likely voters. No additional independent polls were found.

candidates.name: Pat Harrigan
candidates.summary: Pat Harrigan is the incumbent U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 10th Congressional District, first elected in 2024. A former U.S. Army Green Beret and Bronze Star recipient who served in Afghanistan, he is also a successful entrepreneur who co-founded a firearms manufacturing company in Western North Carolina. He holds a degree in Nuclear Engineering from the United States Military Academy at West Point.

career_history.title: Green Beret / Special Forces Officer
career_history.description: Served as an Infantry Platoon Leader and later as a Green Beret. Deployed to Afghanistan twice. Awarded two Bronze Stars.

education.institution: United States Military Academy at West Point

candidates.name: Ashley Bell
candidates.summary: Ashley Bell is the Democratic nominee for North Carolina's 10th Congressional District, having won the March 3, 2026 primary with 47.73% of the vote. She is a board-certified physician assistant practicing family medicine at Atrium Health, holds a Doctor of Medical Science from the University of Lynchburg and a master's in Physician Assistant Studies from Wake Forest University, and has served on the board of the Physician Assistant Education Association. Her campaign focuses on healthcare reform, economic relief, and government accountability.

forecast.rationale: Incumbent Republican Pat Harrigan is favored in North Carolina's 10th District based on the available data. The only general-election poll (March 2026, n=400, ±5% MOE) shows Harrigan leading Democrat Ashley Bell 51% to 38%, with 11% undecided. That 13-point margin, while derived from a single early poll with modest sample size, aligns with the district's character as a western Piedmont/Foothills seat where Republicans are typically competitive. Harrigan also benefits from incumbency and a strong background (West Point, Green Beret, local business founder). Bell is a credible nominee who won a six-candidate primary, but limited polling and the district's redrawn boundaries in October 2025 introduce uncertainty that prevents a 'safe' rating. On balance, a clear Republican advantage is indicated, consistent with the likely_r tier.
